items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: And then I'd play corners with him, you see?

ctx.x: Uh, you played, you played with Johnny Schenk. Yeah. Is that right? Yeah. Well, what did the men, who were the men in that beside you, Mr. Stackler? Who played in that beside you?

With Johnny Schenk. Well, Johnny Schenk. Well, nine times out of ten, the fellow John Deveread, uh, John Deveread, he used to play bass with him. And Johnny Williamson, he used to play guitar with him. Uh-huh. And he used to play violin. And then I'd play corners with him, you see? Uh-huh. But, uh, to tell you the truth, now, for a fellow keeping time with a bass fiddle, you understand? Playing dance music, or two-fourth time, or three-fourth time, any time, or six-eighth time, he was the best man that I ever…
